name: Rook
greeting: Lost that leg at Three Marks. Well, lost the money for the carpenter. The leg followed out of sympathy.
lines: Kael: You could stop wagering the furniture.
Rook: And leave the roof undefended? Brace the stool by the common table. I've a peg that almost fits.

actions.label: I'll brace it.
actions.result: Rook leaves the loose stool beside the common table for Kael to brace.

relationship_event.text: Kael declined to help repair the common-table stool.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I found another brace for the stool. No debt between us. A game, perhaps.
